basis: Frozen Wave-3 predictions per entry (39 route entries over 28 emitting cases), structural-replay-diagnostics.json, SUT source trace in route-evidence-binding-dataflow.md
unit: route entry (one route object / one emitted label occurrence); distinct-label rollup included

secondary_flags.B9_MEASUREMENT_EXTRACTION_GAP: applies to all 39 entries: binding exists in evidence.route_evidence but scorer consumes labels only, so measurement cannot observe any binding

primary_class_rule: B5 when the route label is a genuine service identity (label born with evidence_refs on the same route object; only the serialized shape separates them). B4 when the label itself is not a service identity (heading/meta/fragment text selected as service_type at route construction), because no route-target identity exists to bind evidence to.
b3_rejection_note: B3_LABEL_DERIVED_AFTER_BINDING is rejected: labels and evidence_refs are created together in build_route_candidates before serialization; the serialized form drops the join key.
